name: The Meeting
source:
You are playing as chronically ill person with slight shortsightedness, who has experienced mental health difficulties in the past. You are trying to find a way to connect with the outside world, while staying safe at the same time.

[From [url=https://xymgames.itch.io/the-meeting]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一位患有慢性疾病、略有近视的人，过去也曾经历心理健康方面的困扰。你正试图寻找一种方式，在保障自身安全的同时，与外面的世界建立联系。

[摘自[url=https://xymgames.itch.io/the-meeting]itch.io[/url]]
